crime: At dinner, the kindest girl held {WITCH_NAME} up as proof that anyone could fit in. “There's nothing strange about her at all.” Since childhood, {WITCH_NAME} had been certain she belonged to none of them.

The girl stopped at a corridor bench each evening as prisoners passed between the dining hall and lounge. There, during the busy hour, {WITCH_NAME} strangled the girl with a cord. Her magic made the sounds of the struggle seem like ordinary corridor noise.

She sat beside the body. Passing girls saw only two prisoners resting, overlooking the slumped figure and fallen belongings. When {WITCH_NAME} finally left, the next passerby saw the mark around the girl's throat and raised the alarm.
Comparing their accounts, the prisoners found that the scene had seemed harmless for exactly as long as {WITCH_NAME} stayed beside the body. Her departure had ended the magic concealing it.
fields.epitaph: At last, she was the one thing no one could overlook.
fields.epithet: A Stranger Held Up as Ordinary
execution: A bare white room enclosed her, with nothing else inside. One wall began sliding inward, forcing her back as the space narrowed. It kept moving until it crushed her against the opposite wall.

magic.name: The Unremarking
magic.text: She can make everything around her seem ordinary to other people.
